Alex Chen: Heads-up — BlueArc enablement tonight 9:00pm PT. Maya's out sick and was going to run the 60m workshop. Need a quick coverage plan. :wave:
Priya Sharma: ugh, hope Maya feels better. I'm on with EMEA calls at that time, can't do the full run. Could co-host for first 20m?
Jorge Alvarez: I can take the walk-through + Q&A if we shorten to 45m. Works better for my evening.
Samir Rao: I can cover the hands-on lab portion. If we split it: Jorge intro + demo (25m), Samir lab (20m). Priya co-host and handle live questions.
Alex Chen: That split sounds good. BlueArc has several APAC engineers joining late — can we shift start to 8:30pm PT to help APAC folks catch the tail?
Priya Sharma: 8:30 works for me for the intro. I can push my EMEA calls out 30m.
Jorge Alvarez: ok for me too. Samir?
Samir Rao: 8:30 is fine. I'll update the runbook snippet and drop into calendar.
OnboardingBot: Reminder: BlueArc — enablement session scheduled. 24 RSVPs. Auto-invite sent to workspace channel.
Alex Chen: Quick agenda (draft):
```
8:30-8:35pm PT — Welcome + goals (Priya)
8:35-8:55pm PT — Feature demo + migration checklist (Jorge)
8:55-9:15pm PT — Guided lab + troubleshooting (Samir)
9:15-9:30pm PT — Q&A + next steps (All)
```
Alex Chen: Can everyone confirm they'll update the calendar event and Slack reminder? Also flag: BlueArc renewal is up in 6 weeks — CSM noted incomplete migration items. We should capture a quick checklist in post-session notes for renewal team.
Priya Sharma: I'll add the checklist item: "confirm migration tasks X/Y/Z + success metrics" to the meeting notes.
Jorge Alvarez: I'll add a short pre-read link and a one-paragraph demo summary to the invite.
Samir Rao: I'll post the lab instructions and an abbreviated troubleshooting FAQ to the channel before start.
Alex Chen: If anything changes, react with :x: and ping here. Otherwise I'll update the invite to 8:30pm PT and assign roles. Thanks team.
Priya Sharma: noted — assigning roles in the event now. :white_check_mark:
Jorge Alvarez: done — updated calendar, included APAC-friendly recording option.
Samir Rao: lab doc posted: https://docs.redwood.ai/bluearc-lab (internal).
Alex Chen: Great. Post-session action: Priya will own renewal signal update, Jorge & Samir to provide migration completion status. I'll consolidate and send to renewals.
Priya Sharma: will do.
OnboardingBot: BlueArc session: calendar updated by Alex Chen at 1733456805.
Alex Chen: Final — thanks all. See you at 8:30.
